symbols.note: from gatekit symbols system --dll dx11 --full; '-' addresses (null) mean the method was not found in bg3_dx11.exe; the component lists come from the method parameter types, not from the code.
symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: When moving the story requests ('evaluating: entity shouldBlock') it drops requests for entities that fail a summon test ('not a summons, ignoring'). For each remaining request, and for each entity that lost its party MemberComponent ('MemberComp removed, request remove BlockFollow'), it checks whether the entity has eoc::party::BlockFollowComponent: shouldBlock false and the component present removes it ('removing BlockFollow'); shouldBlock true and the component absent adds it ('adding BlockFollow').
